div.div: Commented on #631 refactor: make template tooling and its tests one bootstrap-owned sync unit

Implementation Plan for #631: make template tooling and its tests one bootstrap-owned unit Context The template's sync boundary is inconsistent. bootstrap.py SYNC_FILES refreshes a subset of the tools/pyproject_template/ tooling modules but no tests, while check_template_updates.py compares the entire tree — so tooling tests ( tests/template/test_*.py ) show up as adoptable drift. A downstream that adopts a tooling test whose implementation wasn't refreshed in the same step gets a non-runnable test (the shape of PR #630: manage.py public-API change + its test in one commit). cleanup.py already sheds template machinery from downstreams ( SETUP_ONLY removes setup_repo.py , migrate_existing_project.py , bootstrap.py ) but never extended that to tests/template/ . Decision (Approach A, narrow scope): treat tooling tests as template-owned — they live and run in the template's own CI, are excluded from the drift checker, and are shed from downstreams via cleanup.py . bootstrap.py SYNC_FILES is unchanged. Scope is tools/pyproject_template/ only; the parallel tools/doit/ + test_doit_*.py case is a follow-up issue. Overview Single source of truth: a TEMPLATE_OWNED_TEST_FILES constant in utils.py (already in SYNC_FILES ), imported by both cleanup.py and check_template_updates.py so the "shed" list and the "exclude from drift" list can never diverge. Drift checker excludes those tests; cleanup.py SETUP_ONLY removes them. Split the two straddler tests so skeleton assertions stay downstream-owned and tooling assertions become template-owned. Coupling-guard warning as a backstop for future straddlers. Docs (inline) + a new template-meta ADR ( needs-adr ). Files to Create/Modify tools/pyproject_template/utils.py — add TEMPLATE_OWNED_TEST_FILES (list of tests/template/test_*.py paths). Canonical list, imported by the two consumers below. tools/pyproject_template/check_template_updates.py — in find_different_files() (~L196-228), skip paths in TEMPLATE_OWNED_TEST_FILES so they never land in different_files . Add the coupling guard (C): when a non-excluded drifted tests/template/test_*.py imports tools/pyproject_template/ and local tooling differs, emit a warning in the report (reuse the existing Logger /report path around L328-349) telling the user to bootstrap --sync first. tools/pyproject_template/cleanup.py — add TEMPLATE_OWNED_TEST_FILES to SETUP_FILES (~L58-64) so SETUP_ONLY sheds them, alongside the existing setup_repo.py / migrate_existing_project.py entries. tests/template/test_properties.py & tests/template/test_utils.py — split straddlers. Skeleton assertions ( package_name.core.greet ) → a downstream-owned test (kept, drift-visible, NOT in the constant). Tooling assertions ( validate_package_name and other tools.pyproject_template.utils ) → template-owned test(s) listed in the constant. Exact file boundaries finalized by inspection during implementation. docs/template/ai-sync-checklist.md — (a) reframe Phase 1 so tooling-refresh ( bootstrap --sync ) is an always-run early step, not first-time-only, with the version-skew caveat ( bootstrap.py is hardwired to BRANCH="main" , so --sync pulls latest — correct for latest, ahead of an older pinned --template-version ); (b) note tooling tests are template-owned (not adopted), and existing downstreams should re-run cleanup once to shed them. docs/decisions/9XXX-*.md — new template-meta ADR via doit adr --template (see below).
Template-owned test list (narrow scope): test_pyproject_template_main.py , test_check_template_updates.py , test_cleanup.py , test_repo_settings.py , test_setup_repo.py , test_bootstrap.py , plus the tooling-owned test(s) split out of the two straddlers. Explicitly kept (drift-visible): test_doit_*.py (out of scope), test_ai_agent_assets.py , test_templates.py , and the skeleton half of the straddler split. Test Plan test_check_template_updates.py : find_different_files() does NOT return template-owned tooling tests even when their content differs; non-excluded tests still surface normally. test_check_template_updates.py : coupling guard warns when a drifted, non-excluded tests/template/test_*.py imports the tooling and local tooling differs; silent otherwise. test_cleanup.py : SETUP_ONLY file set includes every entry of TEMPLATE_OWNED_TEST_FILES . Invariant test (in test_utils.py tooling half): the checker's exclusion set and cleanup's shed set are both sourced from TEMPLATE_OWNED_TEST_FILES , and every listed path exists — guards the two consumers against drifting apart. Straddler split: skeleton test still exercises greet ; tooling test still exercises validate_package_name ; both pass under doit check . Documentation docs/template/ai-sync-checklist.md updated inline (refresh-first + version-skew + tests are template-owned). This is behavior-of-the-change documentation, so it rides in this PR. ADR needed: yes ( needs-adr label present). New 9XXX template-meta ADR (likely 9017), doit adr --template , title "Template tooling and its tests are template-owned". Records: tooling tests are excluded from drift and shed via cleanup; SYNC_FILES unchanged; single source of truth in utils.py ; known limitation (stale-comparator facet remains; self-updating comparator considered and declined). Links to docs/template/ai-sync-checklist.md (satisfies the ADR→docs link rule). Validation doit check passes (tests, lint, type-check, security, spell). Manual: create a fake differing tooling test under a temp "downstream," run find_different_files() — confirm it is not reported; confirm a non-excluded tooling-importing test triggers the guard warning. Manual: python tools/pyproject_template/manage.py --dry-run check still runs clean.
Opened #631 refactor: make template tooling and its tests one bootstrap-owned sync unit
